name: dell_x1026
description: Metrics for Dell Networking X1026 26-port 1GbE switch (Marvell GT-98DX3035B chipset). No vendor-specific SNMP OIDs are exposed — standard IF-MIB covers the 26 GbE ports, 12 port-channel/LAG interfaces, and VLAN interfaces. A thermal sensor entity is declared in ENTITY-MIB but is not readable via ENTITY-SENSOR-MIB. CPU, memory, and LLDP are not available via SNMP.
